quarterly_data.quarter: SemiFive press release: SEMIFIVE Commences Mass Production of HyperAccel's LLM AI (09-08-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Customer HyperAccel: SemiFive has begun mass production of HyperAccel's data center LLM AI inference accelerator 'Bertha' on Samsung Foundry's 4nm process, its first large-scale mass production project on Samsung 4nm, after securing an initial mass production contract; mass production volumes are projected to expand steadily through follow-on purchase orders as HyperAccel's service rollout expands. The chip is a 'Big Die' of more than 500 mm2, delivered as a complete turnkey solution (front-end design and verification through packaging, testing and volume manufacturing supply). It follows mass production of the 'Wisenet 9' AI ASIC for Hanwha Vision's security cameras in Q3 of last year and an HPC AI chip for a Japanese customer in Q2 of this year.
quarterly_data.figure: Samsung 4nm; die more than 500 mm2; data center AI inference accelerator in mass production in Q3 of this year
